card.title: Effortlessly Unbelievable
card.instruction: Be sincerely impressed by how naturally someone inhabits the strange reality, then compete to appear even less surprised.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You greet invisible guests so easily. I wish I had your touch. Actually, I usually hug them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's the umbrella stand. Martin's behind you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Martin! No formalities between us. Come for supper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I usually ask whether he can eat visible food first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Oh, we can skip all that. Martin, help yourself from the fridge whenever. I'll get you a key.

mechanism: A praises B's invisible-guest fluency, then escalates from mistaken familiarity to unlimited hospitality to appear even more at home.
confusable: Unlike sincerely following a strange custom, A is competing over who needs fewer explanations and formalities.
comparison: This alternative responds to a dietary caution by offering a key; the doorway alternative responds to a moment of hesitation by offering to save a cubicle.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
